scope: One isolated spatial-conflict admissible-travel prototype, using existing native training records only.
focus: The 253 current same-ego/foe-path committed-internal cases with observed next-frame simultaneous internal occupancy; keep all 374 current conflicts as a secondary panel.
geometry: First inspect existing real lane shapes and directed foe relations to locate crossing/merging conflict regions. A missing centerline intersection is not proof of no conflict; unlocatable pairs stay unresolved.
candidate: A shared finite distance to the active conflict region, applied both to entering ordinary packets and packets already internal. Allow only the internal prefix before the conflict region; keep receiving/body occupancy and priority constraints.
controls: Current receiving correction, model family, laws, seeds, records and actuator timing remain fixed. Preserve prior failed fits and all original outputs.
readout: Reproduce current cases first; compare structural permission/travel bounds for the full original yield reservoir, including supported positives and zero-label permission expansion/contraction. Observed future paths define diagnostic subgroups only.
after: Inspect geometry coverage and zero-fit comparisons before defining any fresh fitting budget. No claim of actual conflict-point crossing, calibrated entry accuracy or control gain from entry support.
authorized_by: User explicitly requested actual geometry, shared entry/internal constraints and existing-record zero-fit comparison; no new simulation.
geometry_method: Real-width segment capsule proximity; radius is half-width sum, tangencies retained; stored/shape arc mapping; receiver prefix one parsed lane width.
width_source: Frozen SUMO1.22 bundled sumolib.net.readNet; missing XML width resolves by its verified3.2m default, never fitted.
internal_probe: Current native frame t+1 of each of253 clean cases, compared using that frame/action; unavailable final-frame transitions remain not-evaluable, no replacements.
